'''Noraa'Kazz''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was part of an Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] acting as their supply officer specializing in secondary gear.
